name: mummified-hand-single-candidate-seed0
description: Mummified Hand mid-combat relic parity: with hand=[INFLAME (Power), STRIKE_IRONCLAD (Attack)] and the MummifiedHand relic equipped, playing Inflame fires `after_card_played` (POWER branch). The handler picks a random card from the post-play hand whose cost>0 and is non-X-cost — here the post-play hand contains only STRIKE_IRONCLAD, so the choice is deterministic across the Python-MT and Rust-Xoshiro256++ RNG streams (single-candidate pool). Expected post-state: STRIKE_IRONCLAD remaining in hand with cost=0, player.powers includes STRENGTH=2 from Inflame. Pin: sts2-rl-agent@01c094d:sts2_env/relics/rare.py::MummifiedHand (lines 731-758). Rust handler: relic_effects.rs:on_after_card_played_mummified_hand (bead sts2-rs-l36v). Bead sts2-rs-8z3fl.5. ShrinkerBeetle is the empty-encounter sentinel (no incoming damage).

compare.exclude_fields_reason: Cross-language RNG (Python MT vs Rust Xoshiro256++) — ShrinkerBeetle intent triple diverges by design (monsters.rs:22-29). MummifiedHand pick is deterministic here because the candidate pool reduces to size 1 (only STRIKE_IRONCLAD remains after INFLAME plays), so the RNG.choice() call returns the same identity in both engines regardless of stream divergence.
